title: Item socket
wikitext:
{{Redirect|Socket|sockets in the passive skill tree|Jewel socket}} {{Redirect|Links|the the type of skill|Link skill|help with editing hyperlinks|Help:Links}} [[Image:socket.png|thumb|upright|An example of a bow with three linked sockets; two of which are occupied by skill gems.]] '''Item sockets''' are slots on [[equipment]] or [[resonators]] into which other items can be placed. __TOC__ ==Types of sockets== There are 3 types of sockets: * Gem sockets in which [[skill gems]] and [[support gems]] can be socketed. ** Gem sockets can be '''linked''' together, which is required for [[support gems]] to provide benefits to linked [[skill gems]]. ** Any colour of gem can be socketed into any colour of socket. If the colour of the gem matches the colour of the socket, the socketed gem gains +10% [[quality]]. * [[Abyssal socket|Abyss sockets]] in which [[Abyss jewel]]s can be socketed. * [[Resonator]] sockets in which [[fossil]]s can be socketed. ==Gem sockets== Skill gems can be placed into a socket on equipment, allowing your character to use that skill. Support gems can also be placed in these gem sockets to enhance the skill gems they are linked to, as well as the skill granted by the item, if applicable. ===Colours=== Each socket has one of four colours: * White, a neutral colour * Red, associated with [[strength]] * Blue, associated with [[intelligence]] * Green, associated with [[dexterity]] Items will most commonly drop with white sockets, but have a chance to drop with coloured sockets. When an item is generated or its sockets colours are rerolled, the chance for it to roll one or more coloured sockets increases with [[item level]]. Gems of any colour can be placed into any type of coloured socket, but when a red, green, or blue gem is placed into a socket of a matching colour, it gains a +10% gem [[quality]] bonus. The random choice of colour for sockets is weighted based upon the magnitude of the relevant attributes (strength, dexterity, intelligence) required to use the item. For example, a low strength requirement (low base-level) pure strength armour item has a higher probability of rolling off-colour sockets than a high strength requirement (high base-level) pure strength armour. Newly added sockets will always be white. A {{il|Chromatic Orb}} or {{il|Tainted Chromatic Orb}} will reroll the colour of the sockets while guaranteeing at least one of the sockets will be coloured. For Tainted Chromatic Orbs, the resulting socket colour will not be weighed by the item's attribute requirements. The [[crafting bench]] also has crafting recipes that reroll socket colours with a guaranteed minimum number of coloured sockets. It is also possible to turn a white socket into a non-white colour through [[corrupted|corruption]] or [[Locus of Corruption|double corruption]]; these methods ignore the weights from attribute requirements.https://youtu.be/9-xhpd3HdyE?si=RmZri0-6EHQGgfoB&t=777 {{il|Omen of Trichromatism}} will guarantee the next Chromatic Orb will give the item at least one red, green, and blue socket. Certain unique items ({{il|Dialla's Malefaction}}, {{il|Skin of the Lords}}, {{il|Skin of the Loyal}}) have a hidden modifier that prevents the item from having white sockets. ===Number of sockets=== The number of possible sockets on [[equipment]] is based on the [[item level]] as well as the type of the equipment being used. The number of sockets can be changed by {{il|Jeweller's Orb}} reforging, using the [[Crafting Bench]] in your [[hideout]], or an {{il|Orb of Binding}}. Corrupted items can only be changed through the [[Crafting Bench]] and need an equivalent amount of {{il|Vaal Orb}} as the usual cost of {{il|Jeweller's Orb}}, {{il|Chromatic Orb}} and {{il|Orb of Fusing}} to change sockets on any corrupted item, or via the use of {{il|Tainted Jeweller's Orb}}, {{il|Tainted Chromatic Orb}}, and {{il|Tainted Orb of Fusing}}. ====Maximum number of sockets by equipment type==== * Most [[Belts]], [[amulets]], [[rings]] and [[quivers]] do not have sockets. Exceptions are {{il|Unset Ring}}, {{il|Unset Amulet}}, {{il|Black Maw Talisman}}, {{il|Stygian Vise}}, {{il|Ornate Quiver}}, and {{il|Mechanical Belt}}. * [[One-Handed|One-handed weapons]] and [[shield]]s can only have up to 3 sockets max (Exception: {{il|Oni-Goroshi}} and {{il|The Goddess Unleashed}}) * [[Boots]], [[helmet]]s and [[glove]]s can have up to 4 sockets * [[Body armour]]s and [[Two-Handed|Two-handed weapons]] can have up to 6 sockets * Non-unique equipment can have up to 1 Abyssal Socket, with the appropriate modifier on the item. Some items have exceptions to these rules, typically due to special modifiers or low-level base types with a different inventory size. ====Item level==== {| class = "wikitable" ! Number of

Altering the socket count via crafting bench and attempting to use Jeweller's Orbs will cause it to respect item level again. * Items from [[strongboxes]] with {{ml|ChestItemSockets|verbose}} affix can exceed the item level limit. * A specific number of sockets can be crafted on an item using the [[Crafting Bench]] ignoring [[item level]] restrictions * [[Monster modifier]]s that cause items to drop with maximum sockets appear to ignore item level. * Certain [[heist enchantments]] can modify the number of sockets on an item when rolling with a {{il|Tailoring Orb}} or {{il|Tempering Orb}}. ===Links=== Sockets can be linked to other sockets in the same item. In order to provide their benefits support gems have to be placed in sockets linked to other sockets containing skill gems. Multiple support gems of the same type can only be applied once to an skill gem, however it is possible to apply a single support gem to multiple skill gems at once. If multiple support gems of the same type are socketed in the same link, the highest level support is used. :''For example, the two skills {{il|Fireball}} and {{il|Freezing Pulse}} may be linked with {{il|Elemental Proliferation Support}} in a three linked item, or {{il|Freezing Pulse}} may be replaced by {{il|Chance to Ignite Support}} to enhance the {{il|Fireball}} even more. However linking two instances of {{il|Elemental Proliferation Support}} will only provide the bonus of the highest level one.'' The number of links can be reforged using an {{il|Orb of Fusing}}, the [[Crafting Bench]], or an {{il|Orb of Binding}}. ==== Order ====
Generally the order in which skill gems are linked only holds importance for [[trigger gem]]s and for rounding the mana cost. The order for sockets used is: {|style="text-align:center;" |- | 1 | ⇒ | 2 |- | | | ⇓ |- | 4 | ⇐ | 3 |- | ⇓ | | |- | 5 | ⇒ | 6 |} If multiple trigger gems are socketed in several equipped items the order will be: :Main hand ⇒ Amulet ⇒ Helm ⇒ Off hand ⇒ Body armour ⇒ Gloves ⇒ Boots
===Items with non-standard interactions=== ====Base items==== * {{il|Unset Ring|Unset Rings}}, {{il|Black Maw Talisman|Black Maw Talismans}}, and {{il|Mechanical Belt|Mechanical Belts}} have 1 socket, despite being accessories. This socket is granted by its implicit modifier, which is lost if the implicit is replaced. ** {{il|Ornate Quiver|Ornate Quivers}} and {{il|Unset Amulet}} also have 1 socket granted by its implicit. Non-unique bases for these items can only be obtained by corrupting a {{il|Maloney's Mechanism}} or {{il|Uul-Netol's Vow}}, respectively. * {{il|Gnarled Branch}} can only have up to 3 sockets, despite being a two-handed weapon. * {{il|Fishing Rod}} can only have up to 4 sockets, despite being a two-handed weapon. ====Unique items==== * {{il|The Goddess Unleashed}} and {{il|Oni-Goroshi}} always have 6 linked sockets. They are the only one-handed weapons that can have more than three sockets. * {{il|Actum}}, {{il|Kaom's Heart}}, {{il|Replica Kaom's Heart}}, {{il|Kaom's Roots}}, {{il|The Grey Spire}}, and {{il|Vorana's March}} do not have any sockets. * {{il|Malachai's Artifice}} always has a white socket and grants stats based on the colour of the gem socketed into the item. * {{il|Prismatic Eclipse}}, {{il|Scaeva}}, {{il|Crown of the Tyrant}}, and {{il|Triad Grip}} grant stats based on the colour of the sockets in the item. * {{il|Scaeva}} and {{il|Triad Grip}} grant bonuses based on the number of empty gem sockets in the item. * {{il|The Untouched Soul}} grants stats based on the colour of empty sockets on your equipped items. * {{il|Tabula Rasa}} always has 6 white linked sockets. * {{il|Skin of the Loyal}} and {{il|Skin of the Lords}} always come with six linked sockets that are randomly coloured. The number of sockets, links, and their colours cannot be changed. * {{il|Dialla's Malefaction}} always grants the quality bonus to socketed gems as if it had matching colours. It also cannot have white sockets. * {{il|Crown of the Tyrant}} and {{il|Crest of Desire}} always have 1 socket. * {{il|Loreweave}} always has 6 sockets. * {{il|Shadowstitch}} always has 6 linked sockets. * {{il|Maloney's Mechanism}} and {{il|Voidfletcher}} always has 3 sockets, one of which can be lost if replaced by a Vaal implicit. * {{il|Subsume the Source}} cannot have gem sockets, even after is abyssal sockets have been consumed. * {{il|Hand of the Lords}} grants a skill which gains 25% of physical damage gained as extra fire/cold/lightning/chaos damage per red/green/blue/white socket on the gloves respectively. =====Unique items from races===== All [[Descent: Champions Chests#Unique item chests|Descent: Champions unique items]] have three white, linked sockets (except for {{il|Slivers of Providence}} and {{il|Chains of Time}}). ===Related divination cards=== There are [[divination card]]s that grant items with a high number of sockets and links. {{Drop enabled base item table |where= items.class_id="DivinationCard" AND items.description LIKE "%-link%" |description=1 }} ==Passive skills== ===Passive Masteries=== {{Query masteries|where=mastery_effects.stat_text_raw LIKE "%Socket%"}} ==Abyssal socket== {{Main|Abyssal socket}} Abyssal sockets are special types of sockets exclusively found on [[Abyss]]-themed items. A single socket can be found on {{il|Stygian Vise}} and one and two sockets on most Abyss-related uniques. Abyss sockets can also be crafted into an item using a [[Resonator]] with a {{il|Hollow Fossil}}. You can only socket [[abyss jewel]]s into these sockets. The following uniques have abyss sockets: {{Drop enabled unique item table |where=items.stat_text LIKE "%Abyssal%Socket%" }} Abyss sockets take the place of regular sockets, i.e. an item will have the number of maximum coloured sockets reduced by the amount of abyss sockets; for example, a glove with two abyss sockets can only have up to a maximum of 2 coloured sockets. ==Resonator sockets== {{main|Resonator}} Resonators are a special [[currency]] [[item class]] which have sockets for [[fossil]]s. ==Developer Information== {{Split|section=yes|reason=This article is about item sockets as a game mechanic. This information falls outside of that scope}} {{development information|section=yes}} Relevant information about the sockets can be found in the "Sockets" section of .ot files (based on which files the item in question inherits). Numerical ID |- | red | R | 1 |- | green | G | 2 |- | blue | B | 3 |- | white | W | |} ==Version history== {{Version history table header}} {{Version history table row|3.29.0| * Gems can now be Socketed into any Equipment Socket, even if the Gem Colour does not match the Socket Colour. * Socketed Gems now gain +10% to Quality in Red, Green, and Blue Sockets if the Gem colour matches the Socket colour. * Item Sockets are now always White by default. Each Socket generated on an item has a small chance to roll as a Red, Green, or Blue Socket instead, and the selected colour will still be proportional to the attribute requirements of the item. * The chance for Sockets to roll as Red, Green, or Blue increases with higher item levels. }} {{Version history table row|3.21.0| * Ruthless no longer has alternative levels for when you start finding four, five, and six socket items.https://www.reddit.com/r/pathofexile/comments/11r1qfp/comment/jc675mi/ }} {{Version history table row|0.9.3| * It's now much easier to get appropriate socket configurations on items. It's less common to find three-six linked sockets.. }} {{Version history table row|0.8.3| * Increased chance of off-colour sockets spawning on items, slightly. }} {{Version history table row|0.8.0| * It's now slightly more likely to generate an off-colour socket. }} {{Version history table row|0.6.8| * Allowed three sockets to spawn on the highest weapons/armours. }} {{Version history table row|0.6.7| * Made larger socket groups slightly more common. }} {{Version history table end}} ==References== {{reflist|refs= }} {{sister|poe2wiki}} [[Category:Item mechanics]]
